一场舒服的城市野餐，通常从“在哪里坐下”开始。Presidio Tunnel T: A comfortable city picnic usually starts with deciding where to sit. Presidio Tunnel Tops combines transportation, a break, and a short walk, but an open lawn doesn't mean every table is available. Choose public seating or a reserved space before deciding how much food and gear to bring. That's easier than carrying heavy bags around looking for a spot.
集合放在 Transit Center，返程也从这里算: Meet at Transit Center and plan your return from there too
无车可从 Presidio GO 官方页面查看 Downtown Route 到: Without a car, check the Presidio GO official page for the Downtown Route to Presidio Transit Center. It is different from the park's South Hills Route, and some weekday commuter services have separate rider eligibility restrictions. Check times and stops for your date instead of using an old screenshot as a universal schedule. If driving, still agree on a clear public meeting point so friends don't search for each other in different lots.
两种坐法，选一种就够: Choose one of two seating plans
轻装两三人可以先找 Picnic at Transit 的公共座位，或在允许停留: For two or three people traveling light, try the public seats at Picnic at Transit, or rest on lawns or benches where allowed. Public tables aren't guaranteed. If your gathering needs a reserved table, open the Picnic Place page and follow the official reservation link. It says unreserved tables are first-come, first-served, but respect posted reservations; an empty table isn't necessarily available.
围绕 Tunnel Tops 的野餐小行程: A short picnic itinerary around Tunnel Tops
从 Presidio Transit Center 集合，在 Picnic at: Meet at Presidio Transit Center, eat at Picnic at Transit or a picnic area you've checked in advance, take a short scenic walk on open Tunnel Tops paths, then return to the Transit Center. If you've reserved Picnic Place, go to the reserved location first. Going down to the Crissy Field waterfront is optional, not a required extra stop.
认清返程站、卫生间与同行者的联系方式，再一起找座位。: Locate the return stop and restrooms, exchange contact details, then find seating together.
按选定方案野餐: Picnic according to your chosen plan
使用可用公共座位，或前往已核对的预约桌位；不要在通道铺开物品。: Use available public seating or your confirmed reserved table. Don't spread belongings across paths.
收好食物后走开放步道看景，按风势与体力随时回头。: Pack away food, then enjoy the views from open paths. Turn back whenever wind or energy calls for it.
回站前再清点: Take one last inventory before returning to the station
检查包装、餐具和外套是否收齐，留出等车与城市内换乘时间。: Check that you've collected packaging, utensils, and jackets. Leave time to wait for the bus and transfer within the city.
菜单越容易收拾，现场越能放松: An easy-to-clean-up menu makes for a more relaxing picnic
在家把餐食分装成各人容易拿取的小份，带有盖容器、餐巾和回收垃圾袋。需要冷藏的食物: Pack food at home in small, easy-to-serve portions. Bring lidded containers, napkins, and bags for trash and recycling. Transport perishable food in an insulated bag rather than leaving everything out from arrival to departure. If you can't keep it properly chilled, choose a more portable menu. Ask about allergies and dietary needs before anyone arrives and finds they can't eat the meal.
Tunnel Tops 不允许自带烤炉，烧烤只在指定 Picnic Place: You cannot bring your own grill to Tunnel Tops; grilling is limited to designated Picnic Place facilities. If you want to grill, check that area's reservations and rules first. A casual picnic needn't become a large party. Don't use general lawn information to assume canopies, tables, chairs, or decorations are allowed; check the specific restrictions for Picnic Place and East Meadow.
儿童、狗与自行车不能共用一套规则: Kids, dogs, and bikes don't all follow the same rules
带孩子可把 Outpost 当作可选加项，但先确认它自己的开放安排；公园室外空间: With kids, Outpost can be an optional stop, but check its own hours first. Open park grounds don't mean the playground and Field Station are open at the same time. Pets aren't allowed in Outpost, so dog owners need a separate meeting point. Bikes, skateboards, and scooters must be walked through Tunnel Tops; keep riding speeds out of the walking group.
出发前把分工说清楚: Agree on who brings what before leaving
确认公共座位备选或预订地点，并保存预订信息与场地限制。: Confirm backup public seating or a reserved location, and save reservation details and site restrictions.
各人认领水、食物、餐具与垃圾袋，减少重复携带；防风外套人人自备。: Assign water, food, utensils, and trash bags to different people to avoid duplicates. Everyone should bring a wind-resistant jacket.
有狗、有孩子或行动辅助需求时，提前约定可同行的空间与休息点。: If bringing dogs, children, or anyone needing mobility assistance, agree on accessible shared spaces and rest stops in advance.
查返程班次，预先约好天气不适合时取消或缩短，不靠临时搭棚硬撑。: Check return transit and agree beforehand to shorten or cancel in unsuitable weather rather than relying on a makeshift shelter.
把野餐约伴写成清楚的小计划: Turn your picnic meetup into a clear little plan
说明集合点、人数、是否有预约、每人带什么，以及风雨时如何调整。场地预约由参与者自: Specify the meeting point, group size, any reservation, what each person brings, and a plan for wind or rain. Participants confirm their own site reservations.
